'''Excelsior Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The company donned armor with orange markings.<ref name="TCW: DYD: The Lost Legion" />

==History==
During the war, a squad attached to Excelsior Company was sent on a special mission under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vargus]] to [[Battle of Ando Prime|investigate]] the disappearance of the [[313th Legion]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. It included [[16]], [[Ace (clone trooper)|18]] "Ace", [[23]], [[35 (Ando Prime)|35]], [[44]] "Slug", [[57]] "Patch", and some variables like [[Falco (clone trooper)|Falco]], [[Splice]], and [[Dom]] "Bruiser".<ref name="TCW: DYD: The Lost Legion" />
